title: POV: You Finally Understand Why Monday Wrecked You
description: POV: You take a trade Monday morning — confident, clean setup. Then the market reverses and stops you out. Sound familiar? Here's the truth about Monday liquidity sweeps that most traders never learn. R2F Trading breaks down why smart money hunts your stops before the real move begins. This is the ICT concept that changed everything. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily smart money setups.
script: You took a Monday trade. Clean setup. Stopped out in 4 minutes. That wasn't bad luck. Smart money planned it. Every Monday, price sweeps Friday's range first. It hunts your stops — both sides. That false break you saw? That's buyside liquidity being taken. The real move comes after. The R2F Trading system taught us: never enter before the sweep completes. Wait for the fair value gap after. One rule. Stop entering Monday before 9AM London. 80% of stop-outs happen in that window. Follow R2F Trading. We post real setups every day.
